note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions and the PowerPyx roadmap: story first, then the 100% checklist, then loose ends. Times are PowerPyx estimates: story 60 to 80 hours, checklist about 100 hours, cleanup about 10 hours, roughly 200 hours to the platinum.

stages.summary: Play the story through Chapters 1 to 5 and let the story trophies pop as they come. Do the side questlines as they unlock, try the activities that cross your path, and start scanning vehicles and studying animals early so the checklist is half done before the credits. One warning for this stage: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story

stages.summary: After the credits the 100% Completion checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats. Work through it in free-roam: stunts, vehicles, animals, challenges, robberies and collections. Nothing on the checklist is missable and the targets are lenient, about 60% of true completion. Finishing the checklist earns A Long Road and most of the trophies in this stage along the way.
stages.title: Stage 2 — The 100% Completion checklist

stages.summary: The loose ends. Three of these trophies have no confirmed method yet at launch, so check back rather than grinding a rumour: In The Beginning, Bad Luck I Guess and Ten Pin. The Truth Is Out There has a reported UFO method to try at night in Kelly County. Once these are done, the platinum pops.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Strangers, Freaks and loose ends
